name: Compile and categorize diverse lists of items
description: Users asked the assistant to generate, compile, or retrieve extensive lists of items, entities, or resources across diverse domains such as business, technology, media, and linguistics. These requests frequently involved applying specific constraints, such as categorization, ranking, filtering by attributes, or formatting data into structured outputs like tables.
